mapper.sql: SELECT p.source_id, COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(btrim(os.display_name), '')), p.source_id) AS name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived) AS total_papers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.archived) AS archived_papers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED') AS published_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'READY') AS ready_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'UNPROCESSED') AS unprocessed_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'FAILED') AS failed_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'UNSUPPORTED') AS unsupported_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.matched_work_id IS NOT NULL) AS matched_count, MIN(p.year) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived) AS year_min, MAX(p.year) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived) AS year_max, MAX(p.updated_at) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived) AS latest_updated_at FROM v2_paper_read p LEFT JOIN ${schema}.sources os ON os.id = p.source_id WHERE p.source_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(p.source_id) <> '' GROUP BY p.source_id HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived) > 0

WHERE 1 = 1
AND (strpos(lower(name), lower(#{filter.q})) > 0 OR strpos(lower(source_id), lower(#{filter.q})) > 0)
AND failed_count > 0 AND (unprocessed_count > 0 OR ready_count > 0) AND total_papers > 0 AND published_count = total_papers
mapper.select: SELECT count(DISTINCT source_id) AS total_journals, count(*) AS total_papers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED') AS published_papers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE matched_work_id IS NOT NULL) AS matched_papers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed_papers, MIN(year) AS year_min, MAX(year) AS year_max FROM v2_paper_read WHERE NOT archived AND source_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(source_id) <> ''

WITH aggregated AS () SELECT * FROM aggregated
ORDER BY (published_count::double precision / GREATEST(total_papers, 1)) DESC, total_papers DESC, source_id ASC
ORDER BY failed_count DESC, total_papers DESC, source_id ASC
ORDER BY (unprocessed_count + ready_count) DESC, total_papers DESC, source_id ASC
ORDER BY latest_updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, total_papers DESC, source_id ASC
ORDER BY lower(name) ASC, source_id ASC
ORDER BY total_papers DESC, published_count DESC, source_id ASC
OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{size}
WITH aggregated AS () SELECT count(*) FROM aggregated

SELECT p.source_id, COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(btrim(os.display_name), '')), p.source_id) AS name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived) AS total_papers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.archived) AS archived_papers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED') AS published_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'READY') AS ready_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'UNPROCESSED') AS unprocessed_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'FAILED') AS failed_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'UNSUPPORTED') AS unsupported_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.matched_work_id IS NOT NULL) AS matched_count, MIN(p.year) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived) AS year_min, MAX(p.year) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived) AS year_max, MAX(p.updated_at) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived) AS latest_updated_at FROM v2_paper_read p LEFT JOIN ${schema}.sources os ON os.id = p.source_id WHERE p.source_id = #{sourceId} GROUP BY p.source_id
SELECT count(*) FROM work_source WHERE source_id = #{sourceId}

SELECT year, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED') AS published, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'READY') AS ready, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'UNPROCESSED') AS unprocessed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'UNSUPPORTED') AS unsupported, count(*) FILTER (WHERE matched_work_id IS NOT NULL) AS matched FROM v2_paper_read WHERE NOT archived AND source_id = #{sourceId} AND year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year ORDER BY year ASC
